title: Host: e2s = e2r (NAT-199) with the user-exception trace on by default (user_exception_trace_enabled 0 -> 1, boot-arg systrace not set, so the system-call and exec traces stay off): every user EXC_BAD_ACCESS/BAD_INSTRUCTION/ARITHMETIC/BREAKPOINT prints pc/lr/sp/slide, register texts and frames before delivery, for mediaserverd's SIGSEGV loop, the candidate source of SpringBoard's missing routingContextUID (NAT-200)
acceptance: The patch is NAT-199's plus the one default line; the kernel differs from NAT-199's only in UUID, same-length build paths and that byte; symbols and segments in place; loader sites rc 0
Command line = e2r's with the tag changed and no systrace token
trap202 analyser tested on lines built from the source's own printf formats; package, counted session, registered criteria for the native run
